verdict.line: You lose if you walk into a telegraphed Shadow Dash with no Valor charge saved; you win if you force the fight while Shadow Dash and Feint are both down.

brief.thesis: Shen's entire lane plan is two cooldowns: Shadow Dash (E) to taunt-lock you and Feint (W) to no-sell the burst that follows. Neither resets fast early (16s and 9s at rank 1), so Riven's 52.2% win rate over 655 games comes from punishing the windows between them, not from winning straight trades into a shielded, taunting opponent.

theirWindow.when: Shadow Dash and Feint both available
theirWindow.what: He can taunt you with E then shield through your response with W. Don't commit your full Q-W combo here — bait one of the two first.

yourWindow.when: Shadow Dash and Feint both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Walk Q (Broken Wings) in, land W (Ki Burst) for the stun, and dump charges — there's no taunt to interrupt you and no shield to eat the damage.

start.why: The 53.8% winrate, 92.5%-picked start — the extra sustain and AD let you contest Vorpal Blade poke without losing the trade war.

boots.why: 56.8% win rate and the majority pick — the ability haste tightens your Q/W/E cooldowns so you can threaten through Shadow Dash's downtime more often.

core.why: Highest-performing opener in the data (68.5% over this build path) — the cooldown refund rewards punishing every window Shadow Dash and Feint are both down.
Sustains you through Vorpal Blade poke and scales your all-in damage once itemized.
Converts burst into survivable damage, letting you stay in range to punish Shen's cooldowns repeatedly instead of one-and-done trades.

he builds into armor and your autos start bouncing off his base kit

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this lane forces — every poke exchange with Vorpal Blade and every all-in window builds toward the healing that offsets Shen's sustain.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 95.8% of games at 54.4% win rate — Ignite punishes Vorpal Blade's lifesteal and closes out all-ins before Feint can be recast. Flash+Teleport (34.8% win rate) is the alternate pick if you expect a scaling, low-kill-pressure lane instead.

playing.title: Bait Feint before committing
playing.detail: Poke with Q (Broken Wings) first to force Shen's W (Feint, cd 9-5s) on cooldown before you dump your real combo — a shielded Shen eats your burst for free.

playing.title: Track Shadow Dash cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Shen's E (Shadow Dash, cd 16-8s, range 575) is his only lockdown tool — treat every window it's down as your green light to all-in, and every window it's up as a reason to hold position.

playing.title: Use Valor to close distance, not just escape
playing.detail: Riven's E (Valor) steps forward and blocks incoming damage — use it to dash back onto Shen after he fires Vorpal Blade (Q) at range rather than saving it purely defensively.

playing.title: Punish Vorpal Blade poke directly
playing.detail: Shen's Q (Vorpal Blade, cd 6-4s, range 475) heals him on hit — don't eat it passively; step into your own Q range to trade back immediately.

playing.title: Save Ki Burst for the taunt
playing.detail: If he does land Shadow Dash, your W (Ki Burst, cd 11-7s) stun immediately after flips the exchange back in your favor instead of letting him walk away.

playing.title: Itemize to beat the shield outright
playing.detail: Build toward Eclipse or Axiom Arc fast enough that a single clean combo still threatens a kill even through Feint's damage absorption.

playing.title: Bank the lead into tempo, not a 5v5 scale
playing.detail: Your edge is concentrated pre-six-item teamfights — convert lane wins into plates and roams rather than waiting for a late game where Shen's W/R utility matters more.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning for when to trade and all-in is our own tactical read on the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Shen’s Taunt ability. Engage when your Conqueror’s stacks up and when enemy abilities are on cooldown.
